resources.string: Reads touch positions for hitboxes in touch mode.
Shows the overlay in both modes and receives physical keyboard input.
1. Install and start Shizuku using its in-app instructions.\n2. Return here, tap Allow Shizuku and confirm.\n3. Enable Accessibility separately in Settings to show the overlay.

1. Open Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps.
2. Select Key Viewer Overlay and manually enable its service (TouchRendererService).
3. Return here and wait for Connected. If it stays connecting, check the service in Settings.
Cannot find it? Search for “Accessibility” in system Settings.
This permission reads touch events through getevent. It does not simulate touches or enable Accessibility. Keyboard mode does not need Shizuku.
The service draws a touch-through overlay and receives mapped keys. It does not read screen content. You can turn it off at any time in Settings.
